nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: native Nintendo Switch release on 2025-03-20 and native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on 2026-02-19. Switch 2 Edition supports up to 4K / 60 fps in TV mode and up to 1080p / 60 fps handheld. Online squads can include up to 32 players; Nintendo Switch Online is required only for online features.

Supplier language selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese.
Supplier matrix: NS1 Regular ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); NS1 Standard ¥95; NS2 Regular ¥11.7; NS2 Standard ¥114.6. Two supplier variants per platform means no paid DLC product type is created.
Converted purchase costs at 1 CNY = 220 IQD, rounded down to nearest 250 IQD: NS1 Regular 1,250 IQD; NS1 Standard 20,750 IQD; NS2 Regular 2,500 IQD; NS2 Standard 25,000 IQD.
The template has one cost per product type and no platform-specific cost subfield; therefore dual-platform type.cost fields are intentionally left blank rather than mixing NS1 and NS2 costs.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore Mira
gameplayPillars.description: Exploration is central: the player surveys continents, plants probes, discovers landmarks, gathers materials, and opens new routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Master Arts and Classes
gameplayPillars.description: Real-time party combat uses auto-attacks, Arts, positioning, cooldowns, class progression, equipment, and coordinated party roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Pilot Skells
gameplayPillars.description: Skells add a second layer of movement and battle, allowing faster traversal, flight later in progression, and large-scale combat.

worldSummary: Mira is a massive alien planet divided into distinct regions with different climates, ecosystems, creatures, resources, and ruins. New Los Angeles serves as humanity’s base after the White Whale crash.

storyChapters.title: The White Whale and New Los Angeles
storyChapters.body: The White Whale escapes Earth’s destruction but crashes on Mira. Survivors establish New Los Angeles and race to secure humanity’s future.

storyChapters.title: Life on Mira
storyChapters.body: BLADE explores Mira, rescues survivors, studies alien life, and uncovers competing factions and mysteries surrounding the planet.

storyChapters.title: The fight for humanity’s future
storyChapters.body: The story expands beyond the original Wii U release with additional narrative material included in the Definitive Edition.

features: Large seamless regions across planet Mira
Online squads for up to 32 players
perfNotes: Nintendo Switch: measured target is 30 fps, with dynamic resolution reaching about 1080p docked and 720p handheld. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: Nintendo officially advertises up to 4K / 60 fps TV and up to 1080p / 60 fps handheld. Actual rendering resolution can differ from output resolution.
storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.5 GB for Nintendo Switch and 14.8 GB for Nintendo Switch 2 on the current product page.
verdictSummary: A critically well-received, unusually large science-fiction RPG whose strongest qualities are exploration, world scale, customization, and Skell gameplay. Its dense systems and long runtime make it best suited to players who enjoy deep RPG progression.
